title: The version dates, status and approver of the permission matrix, its four operations and the right of the load are not specified in the sources
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Administration Stories v3.md (RWB-AD-002); Recovery Workbench TSD P4 Access and administration v3 (T3.0, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T6.1, appendix T-A.1); Recovery Workbench FSD P4 Access and administration v3 (A2.4); Ownership Map v1
description: (a) `permission` carries `matrix_version` (DF-REF-044) and the standard `state` column of TSD P4 v3 T3.0 and no valid-from date, valid-to date or approver reference, while legacy AC3 needs an approved version with a valid from date and the story needs LOADED, VALIDATED, APPROVED and IN_FORCE; (b) the matrix load, the matrix read, the version read and the versions list have no row in the ownership map and none in TSD P4 v3 appendix T-A, whose only role read is GET /admin/roles (API-P4-007) and whose reference-load paths (API-P4-005, API-P4-006, API-P4-009, API-P4-010) are P3 rwb-case's under ASM-A6-api-4; (c) the legacy Permission checks table gives the load the C letter of Reference data for RW-COE and RW-REFADM and the approval the A letter of Rules and parameters for RW-RISK, while TSD P4 v3 T6.1 holds the permission rows in Platform administration (RW-SECADM CRUDA, RW-PLATADM CRUD, RW-AUDIT R) and gives RW-REFADM no right there; (d) the legacy criterion names the application owner's approval and TSD P4 v3 T6.1 holds no application-owner role and no approval right for the `permission` table, so the approver of a matrix version is unfixed; (e) the number of roles a complete matrix must cover is not stated — TSD P4 v3 T6.1 lists 42 role codes while the criteria of the same matrix count 54 roles and 756 rows; (f) where the load form sits on a screen is not stated, and the legacy screens SCR-39 and SCR-40 belong to the rule-version and reference-list stories.
evidence: TSD P4 v3 T3.1 (DF-REF-040 to DF-REF-044, no date and no approver column), T3.2 (LOV-VERSION-STATUS and LOV-CAPABILITY), T6.1 (42 role rows, three capability columns), appendix T-A.1 (API-P4-004 to API-P4-021, no matrix path); FSD P4 v3 A2.4 field catalog and AC-P4-004-01 (matrix file PM-2026.12 with 756 rows); legacy RWB-AD-002 Permission checks, Endpoints and Screen and states tables.
proposed: Carry the status in the standard `state` column of `permission`, add the valid-from, valid-to and approver-reference columns by this key's migration, fix the four operations on `/api/recovery/access/v1` with Platform administration R and C, read the approver role from `rwb.refload.approver.permission`, compute the expected row count from `role` and LOV-CAPABILITY, and serve the rows through SCR-43 with the placement of the load form left to the screen owner.

title: The matrix contract shapes, its status at the end of a load, its event payload and its baseline rules are not specified
source: Recovery Workbench TSD P4 Access and administration v3 (T3.0, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T6.1, appendix T-A.1); 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Administration Stories v3.md (RWB-AD-002); Recovery Workbench FSD P4 Access and administration v3 (A2.4); Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 (slides 11, 14, 20, 41, 42, 43); Ownership Map v1
description: (a) the field names, types and lengths of the matrix row, the matrix, the version and the page, and the valid-from, valid-to, approver reference and pending approver role, have no physical definition in any source; (b) the paths, the rights, the request and answer shapes and the error responses of the four operations have no ownership-map row and none in TSD P4 v3 appendix T-A; (c) the state of a version at the end of a load is not stated for the matrix and is taken from LOV-VERSION-STATUS, with no source saying whether a load ends LOADED or VALIDATED; (d) no source names the payload of an access-policy event for a matrix version — the change kind MATRIX and the decision codes AC-VERS and AC-DENY are this revision's use of the service's existing vocabulary — and the point of publication (load, approval or effective date) is not stated; (e) the deprecation window of a published field and the retention of the contract fakes are not stated, and no approval record exists for a Draft baseline under D-RCV-60.
evidence: TSD P4 v3 T3.1 (no version, status or date column on `permission` beyond matrix_version), T4 (the rule package lifecycle only), T5.3 (events: none), appendix T-A.1 (no matrix path); Architecture v5 slides 14, 20 and 43 (two access event names, cached permission refresh); legacy RWB-AD-002 Acceptance criteria and Validation and messages.
proposed: The contract baseline fixes the four schemas, the four paths and their rights, VALIDATED as the end state of a load, `rwb.access.AccessPolicyChanged.v1` with change kind `MATRIX` published after the commit, an additive-only change rule within major version 1, and a deprecation window and fake retention to be confirmed by the solution architect.
